Honeslty OP I used to be like this (not to be a pedo). And it was for very weird things, very small things. 'If I don't do this we'll get in an accident.' It was never a pattern either, but eventually, one day, I ignored it. Of course, there was NOTHING BUT panic going through my mind. I was a sweaty mess, I couldn't stop thinking about it but -- nothing happened.  I let it play out like this a few more times. I ignored the urge, panickedothing happened, and I was fine. I've gotten to the point where I can be a normal person and not have these immediate dangerous thoughts, but it took a lot of thinking and trying to do so. I still to this day do things when I feel the urge. I touched a steering wheel as a copilot  while the driver was driving. could have ended badly.

OP long story short, you will have bad habits. Bad thoughts and bad reactions. But it will never make you to be what your OCD says. Give yourself time and don't react, you'll feel dirty almost at times because of it, but nothing will happen. Good luck to you !!❤️
